activity.notes: Viriathus rallied the Lusitani against Roman expansion and was their war-leader by 147 BCE. The start boundary marks securely attested leadership by that year rather than a formal accession date; he was assassinated in 139 BCE. ATLAS uses the Lusitani themselves rather than the later Roman province of Lusitania or the overly broad label Iberians.

sources.title: Viriatus, c. 180–139 BCE — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford states that Viriatus rallied the Lusitani, became their war-leader by 147 BCE, fought to preserve Lusitanian independence, and was assassinated in 139 BCE.
